pages.reason: 读取全部9项一手快照：8项与基线一致；Steam当前一手数据将Dumpster Gang日期从12月4日更正为12月3日，已提交替换补丁。
读取全部3项：Nintendo一手页确认DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS与Rayman Legends Retold的12月3日Switch 2范围；Steam及游戏官方公告确认Arkheron于11月27日覆盖PC、PS5与Xbox Series X|S，均与基线一致。
读取全部4项：Steam一手快照确认Am I Nima于11月27日、Climb, Cube, Climb!于11月23日发售，已新增；Thief页面在packet内文字受限，另以Atari、PlayStation、Steam和Xbox官方页面核对12月3日及平台范围；GTA VI已过日历起点。
读取全部2项：11月9日至13日Xbox周报已过期；Hounded仅标2027年且超出11月22日至12月6日刷新范围，均不提交补丁。
读取当前Xbox 11月23日至27日完整周报及12条基线；周报覆盖与Arkheron官方信息一致，其余基线逐条核对身份、日期、平台、地区和发售类型，无额外删除依据。
读取3条剩余基线和7个候选：保留Thief、Monster Hunter Wilds与Dumpster Gang主体；更正Dumpster Gang日期；官方商店分别确认The Great Villainess美国Switch 2与PS5的12月2日行；The Road of Dust and Sorrow已延期至2027年2月19日，不补入旧日期。
读取12个候选与4条复核链接，并逐一对照官方商店或发行商材料：新增Climb, Cube, Climb!、Am I Nima、The Great Villainess和Edge of Memories；既有Gothic 3 Classic、Luma Island、Arkheron与Thief保持不变。

platforms.reason: 读取本包全部Steam一手快照，并补核Edge of Memories及已延期的The Road of Dust and Sorrow；新增两款PC游戏、Edge of Memories，且更正Dumpster Gang日期。
检查PlayStation Blog、PlayStation Store及发行商官方材料；确认Gothic 3 Classic、Luma Island、Arkheron、Thief与Edge of Memories，另按美国商店日期新增The Great Villainess PS5行。
读取11月23日至27日Xbox完整周报，并核对Arkheron、Gothic 3 Classic、Luma Island、Thief和Edge of Memories的一手发行信息；未发现需移除的既有Xbox行。
读取Nintendo商品页及发行商官方页面；确认DQM、Rayman、Monster Hunter Wilds与Thief，并按美国商品页新增The Great Villainess Switch 2行；Gothic 3 Classic的Switch 2版仍为2027年初，未误并入11月24日。

archiveTitle: 日报｜《侠盗猎车手VI》首日零售额达37.9亿美元

decisions.verification: 已按packet事实边界审阅。
decisions.reason: 多游戏周报作为日历一手证据逐项处理，不以无稳定单一主体的汇总页生成新闻条目。

decisions.verification: 已按packet事实边界审阅。
decisions.reason: 播客为多话题闲聊汇总，没有足够集中的独立核心事件。

decisions.verification: 已按packet事实边界审阅。
decisions.reason: 玩家截图征集属于社区展示，缺少本期需要的产品或行业事实。

decisions.headline: 《侠盗猎车手VI》Metacritic用户评分解禁，约2万份评价均分5.4
decisions.summary: Metacritic开放用户评分后迅速收到约2万份评价，平均分为5.4/10；高低评价近乎各半，正面意见称赞世界塑造，负面意见则集中在帧率与漏洞。
decisions.verification: 已打开媒体正文；评分数量、均分与评价分布均限定为报道撰写时点。
decisions.reason: 形成可核验的上市后口碑截面，且与销售纪录互补。

decisions.verification: 已按packet事实边界审阅。
decisions.reason: 仅为Nintendo新闻索引页，没有可归属的单一新事实。

decisions.headline: 《侠盗猎车手VI》首日零售额达37.9亿美元，预售量为3250万份
decisions.summary: Take-Two与Rockstar确认，《侠盗猎车手VI》上市24小时零售额达到37.9亿美元，预售量为3250万份；游戏已于11月19日登陆PS5与Xbox Series X|S。
decisions.verification: 已打开IGN正文；数字明确归因于Take-Two与Rockstar的确认。
decisions.reason: 具备确定主体、核心数字和平台范围，是本期最重要的行业事件。

decisions.verification: 已按packet事实边界审阅。
decisions.reason: 衍生小说公布与本期游戏核心动态相比优先级较低。

decisions.headline: 育碧裁撤蒙特利尔与魁北克166个岗位，同时成立AI工作室Motherbrain
decisions.summary: 育碧宣布旗下蒙特利尔与魁北克团队合计裁减166人，并在随后财报中公开专注游戏AI技术的新工作室Motherbrain，方向包含可保留记忆的NPC。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON正文；裁员规模与新工作室均归因于育碧公告及财报。
decisions.reason: 同日的人事收缩与AI投资具有明确行业意义。

decisions.headline: 多人浏览器游戏《Internet 4》公布，12月4日开启Steam抢先体验
decisions.summary: 开发者Xiick公布《Internet 4》：最多8人可共同操作同一个浏览器，并通过钓鱼、绘画等功能一起游玩；Windows版计划12月4日在Steam开启抢先体验。
decisions.verification: 已打开报道正文；玩法、人数、日期和平台均来自开发者公告及已公开商店页。
decisions.reason: 概念、人数与发布日期均明确，具备独立新闻价值。

decisions.headline: 《1666: Amsterdam》首个大型抢先体验更新定于12月推出
decisions.summary: Panache Digital Games公布首个大型更新，将加入新区域Ouderkerk、新的超自然能力与一名Original；新区域略大于当前地图，更新后抢先体验价格不变。
decisions.verification: 已打开Gematsu正文；内容与价格信息均明确归因于开发商。
decisions.reason: 首个大型路线图节点，新增区域和系统范围明确。

decisions.headline: 心理恐怖游戏《Baptiste》延期至2027年3月25日
decisions.summary: Digital Dreams与Firenut Games将《Baptiste》从2026年秋季延期至2027年3月25日，目标平台为PS5、Xbox Series X|S、Nintendo Switch 2与PC。
decisions.verification: 已打开Gematsu正文；新日期、原窗口与平台范围均有明确陈述。
decisions.reason: 跨平台发行计划发生实质变更。

decisions.headline: 《Dual Orb Collection》公布，2027年3月18日在日本登陆Switch
decisions.summary: Mebius公布《Dual Orb Collection》，将收录Super Famicom时期的《Dual Orb》与《Dual Orb II》，并于2027年3月18日在日本推出Nintendo Switch版。
decisions.verification: 已打开Gematsu正文；收录内容、日期、平台与地区均明确。
decisions.reason: 两款旧作首次以明确合集形式登陆现行平台。

decisions.headline: 《Saihate Station: Twilight Edition》公布，2027年3月25日登陆Switch
decisions.summary: PLAYISM与viv公布Switch版，收录本体、DLC《Twilight Railway》及两款小游戏；计划2027年3月25日全球发售，并支持简繁中文等语言。
decisions.verification: 已打开Gematsu正文；内容、全球日期、平台和语言支持均明确。
decisions.reason: 新增主机版并整合本体、DLC和额外内容。

decisions.headline: 《绝区零》3.4版本“长日终尽”定于12月2日上线
decisions.summary: 3.4版本将推进洛斯凯法利尔主线至高潮，加入虚狩“挽昼”，并启动与《崩坏：星穹铁道》的联动，带来知更鸟与卡芙卡两名联动代理人。
decisions.verification: 已打开Gematsu正文，并用米哈游官方页面核对版本中文名、上线日与角色中文名；未扩写packet之外的事件事实。
decisions.reason: 版本日期、核心角色与跨作品联动均已明确。

decisions.headline: 《侠盗猎车手VI》移除系列旧有性交易机制，Rockstar强调双主角关系
decisions.summary: 报道指出本作不再允许玩家使用系列旧有的性交易机制。Rockstar向Shacknews解释，保留的系统都服务于杰森与露西亚的故事、情感和动机。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON正文；机制描述来自实机观察，设计意图明确转述Rockstar回应。
decisions.reason: 属于对系列长期机制与叙事方向的实质设计变化。

decisions.summary: 报道援引美国市场排行称，本作虽在10月22日才发售，仍取得当月总榜第六、新作榜第四；另在报道时点拥有约4.3万Steam同时在线峰值。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON正文；销售名次为媒体转述，在线人数为报道时点数据，均未外推销量。
decisions.reason: 提供跨平台新作在美国首月的可量化市场信号。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Grand Theft Auto VI reaches $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI draws about 20,000 Metacritic user ratings
entries.summary: Metacritic had received about 20,000 user ratings at the time of the report, averaging 5.4 out of 10. Positive and negative ratings were nearly evenly split, with praise for the world and criticism of frame-rate drops and bugs.
entries.verification: The opened media report supports the snapshot; counts and scores are time-bound.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI reaches $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales
entries.summary: Take-Two and Rockstar confirmed $3.79 billion in retail sales during the first 24 hours and 32.5 million pre-sale units. The game launched on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report explicitly attributes the figures to Take-Two and Rockstar.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Ubisoft cuts 166 jobs while launching AI-focused studio Motherbrain
entries.summary: Ubisoft announced 166 job cuts across its Montreal and Quebec teams, then disclosed Motherbrain, a new studio focused on game AI technology including persistent-memory NPCs.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes both the job cuts and studio announcement to Ubisoft and its financial presentation.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Internet 4 brings an eight-player shared browser to Steam Early Access
entries.summary: Developer Xiick announced a shared-browser game for up to eight players, with activities such as fishing and drawing. The Windows version is due in Steam Early Access on December 4.
entries.verification: The opened report ties the concept, player count, date and platform to the developer announcement and store page.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: 1666: Amsterdam schedules its first major Early Access update for December
entries.summary: Panache Digital Games says the update will add Ouderkerk, a region slightly larger than the current area, plus new supernatural abilities and another Original. The Early Access price will remain unchanged.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly attributes the update scope and pricing to the developer.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Baptiste moves to March 25, 2027
entries.summary: Digital Dreams and Firenut Games delayed the psychological horror title from fall 2026 to March 25, 2027, for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2 and PC.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report states the old window, new date and platform scope.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Dual Orb Collection brings two Super Famicom RPGs to Switch
entries.summary: Mebius announced a collection of Dual Orb and Dual Orb II for Nintendo Switch, due March 18, 2027 in Japan.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report states the contents, date, platform and region.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Saihate Station: Twilight Edition heads to Switch on March 25, 2027
entries.summary: PLAYISM and viv announced a Switch package containing the base game, Twilight Railway DLC and two mini-games. It is due worldwide with Simplified and Traditional Chinese among its supported languages.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report states the package contents, worldwide date, platform and language support.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Zenless Zone Zero version 3.4 launches December 2
entries.summary: The Finality of the Day brings the Roscaelifer storyline to its climax, adds Sunbringer, and begins the Honkai: Star Rail crossover with Robin and Kafka as crossover Agents.
entries.verification: The opened report supports the update facts; the official miHoYo page was used only to verify Chinese terminology.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: OpenTracks restores rhythm-game use under its standard license
entries.summary: OpenTracks, formerly DOVA-SYNDROME, says music and rhythm games may use its tracks under the standard license as long as required composer credits are displayed.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes the revised policy to OpenTracks' November 20 notice.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI drops a long-running sex-work mechanic
entries.summary: The report says the game no longer lets players use the series' former sex-work mechanic. Rockstar told Shacknews that implemented systems were chosen to serve Jason and Lucia's story, emotions and motivations.
entries.verification: The opened report combines observed mechanics with an explicitly attributed Rockstar explanation.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Final Fantasy Resonance ranks sixth in U.S. game sales for October
entries.summary: The report says the October 22 release still placed sixth overall and fourth among new releases in the U.S. monthly chart. It also cites a Steam concurrent-player peak of about 43,000 at the time of reporting.
entries.verification: The opened report supports the rankings and time-bound concurrency figure; neither is extrapolated into unit sales.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.
